args.title: Freight Market Summary (2026)
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, with fuel surcharges now tracking weekly diesel price movements.
- Shippers who diversified volume across three carriers achieved the lowest overall freight costs.
- Together, this suggests softening spot-market pricing favors flexible, multi-carrier sourcing strategies over single-carrier contracts in the near term.
